manifest.target: Gemma 4 12B IT, native FP8 attention and NVFP4 dense weights, or derived compatibility GGUF

fixture.rule: Parse source as comma-separated decimal integers. Form [source[0]] + repeat(source[1:]); take the first required number of IDs. Input contains its only BOS at index zero. Submit the IDs without additional templating, tokenization, or BOS insertion.

sampler.generation_note: EOS handling varies by interface. Preserve EOS as an eligible nonterminating token where exposed and report any unavoidable EOS logit suppression or control-token handling. Engine RNG and speculative acceptance can yield different sequences even with the same sampling parameters. Record the output IDs and actual length.

run.primer_rule: For a warm point, begin with the exact first prefix_ids of the measured prompt. Prime using one output ID and discard that output. Measure only the full append request, and record the backend's actual prefix hits and computed prompt IDs. For cold points the measured request has zero cached IDs.
run.ttft: Elapsed from measured raw-ID request submission to first emitted model ID. Keep engine-native clocks and boundary differences separately.
run.decode: 127 divided by elapsed seconds from first through last emitted model ID. Preserve alternative native counters with their timing boundaries.
